assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG creature apparition for an elegant 3D anime fantasy fishing game. Entire subject isolated on true transparent background, no ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no circles/halo/rings, no large background splash. Subject: a majestic compact seven-tailed fox spirit, ivory-peach and maple-amber crystal with warm ember-red contours. A graceful fox with long tapered snout, sharp almond amber eyes and erect triangular ears; fierce focused expression, not smiling. Four anatomically clear limbs in a low prowling leap toward the right, front right forepaw reaching forward, hind legs folded under torso, slim waist and thick sculpted chest fur. Seven flowing voluminous translucent flame tails arise continuously from its haunch and fan in a sweeping high crescent behind/above, each has fine fur striations and amber crystalline tips. Tails are softly separated, never straight spikes. Three-quarter side view facing right, fox head near right centre, rich carved flame-fur detail and maple-shaped gold inlays at the brow, elegant rather than cluttered.
